site.name: shkriuss
site.description: Small, private web apps. Your data stays on your device unless you choose to sync it, or to get reminders while an app is closed.

apps.name: Tally
apps.description: Count anything with a tap. Your counts stay on your device unless you turn on sync.
dataStored: Counter names and counts
If you turn on sync: a copy of your counters on Tally's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.name: Calendar
apps.description: Plan your days. Your events stay on your device unless you turn on sync or reminders while it's closed.
dataStored: Your events: titles, dates, times, repeats, reminders and notes
When reminders were last checked, so each one shows only once

If you turn on reminders while Calendar is closed: this device's notification settings and a random device key (never in backups; after you turn it off, kept only until the server has deleted your reminders)

If you turn on sync: a copy of your events on Calendar's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups). A deleted event's id stays there and on your devices for 180 days, so your other devices delete it too (for an imported event, the id from its calendar file)
Which holidays and fasts to show
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.name: Notes
apps.description: Write things down. Your notes stay on your device unless you turn on sync.
dataStored: Your notes: their titles and text, when each was written and last edited, and whether it's pinned
If you turn on sync: a copy of your notes on Notes' server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.name: Habits
apps.description: Build habits one day at a time. Your progress stays on your device unless you turn on sync or reminders while it's closed.
dataStored: Your habits: their names, the days you plan them for and their reminder times
Which days you marked each habit done
When reminders were last checked, so each one shows only once

If you turn on reminders while Habits is closed: this device's notification settings and a random device key (never in backups; after you turn it off, kept only until the server has deleted your reminders)
If you turn on sync: a copy of your habits and check marks on Habits' server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.name: Grammar
apps.description: Check your English, American or British. Your text never leaves your device.
dataStored: The text you're checking, so it's still here when you come back
Whether you write American or British English
Words you added to your dictionary

If you turn on sync: a copy of your dictionary and your English choice (never your text) on Grammar's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups). A word you remove stays there and on your devices, hidden, for 180 days, so your other devices remove it too
The Deep check model, if you download it (381 MB), so it works offline. You can remove it any time
Your light or dark theme choice

Your categories: the ones you added, renamed or removed
If you turn on sync: a copy of your items and categories on Shelf's server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.description: Your to-do list, with due dates, lists and reminders. It stays on your device unless you turn on sync or reminders while it's closed.
dataStored: Your tasks: their titles, notes, steps, dates and times, how they repeat, reminders, lists, which are important and when you finished them
Your lists: their names
Whether you see tasks by date or in your own order (on this device only)
When reminders were last checked, so each one shows only once

If you turn on reminders while Tasks is closed: this device's notification settings and a random device key (never in backups; after you turn it off, kept only until the server has deleted your reminders)
If you turn on sync: a copy of your tasks and lists on Tasks' server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups)
Your light or dark theme choice

Your meals: their names, ingredients and notes
Your shopping lists: what you added and what you ticked off (kept for 8 weeks)
Your reminder times for each meal of the day
When reminders were last checked, so each one shows only once

If you turn on reminders while Meals is closed: this device's notification settings and a random device key (never in backups; after you turn it off, kept only until the server has deleted your reminders)

If you turn on sync: a copy of your plan, meals, shopping lists and reminder times on Meals' server, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and this device's sync key (never in backups). An ingredient you untick, or whose list is let go after 8 weeks, stays there and on your devices, hidden, for 180 days (its name and the list's week), so your other devices remove it too
Your light or dark theme choice

apps.description: Your photos, kept as the original files. On your device, and online too if you turn on sync.

If you turn on sync: every photo in your online library, locked on your devices so only they can read it, and on this device the thumbnails of photos added on your other devices, how far it has caught up, and its sync key (never in backups)
